source: Traced from the Copernicus 90 m DEM (flow directions); areas are approximate (about ±10-15% on flat floodplain country)

catchments.name: Wilkie Creek
catchments.note: to its junction with the Condamine north-west of Dalby

catchments.name: Myall Creek
catchments.note: through Dalby, to its junction with the Condamine west of Dalby

catchments.name: Hodgson Creek
catchments.note: from the range south of Toowoomba (Hodgson Vale), past Cambooya, Greenmount and Southbrook, to the Condamine west of Brookstead

catchments.name: Jimbour Creek
catchments.note: through Jimbour and Macalister, to its junction with the Condamine

catchments.name: Condamine River above Tummaville
catchments.note: the top of the river: Killarney, the Main Range, Warwick, Allora, Clifton and Leyburn country, down to the Tummaville gauge

catchments.name: Condamine River, Tummaville to Dalby
catchments.note: the river's own country between Tummaville and Dalby (Brookstead, Cecil Plains, Pittsworth, Millmerran side), including Hodgson Creek and the North Branch; not the country above Tummaville

catchments.name: Condamine River, Dalby to Chinchilla Weir
catchments.note: the river's own country below Dalby to Chinchilla Weir, including Myall, Wilkie, Jimbour and Jandowae creeks; not the country above Dalby

catchments.name: Jandowae Creek
catchments.note: from the Bunya Mountains side past Cooranga and Jandowae, to the Condamine near Brigalow (downstream of Warra)

catchments.name: Jinghi Jinghi (Jingi Jingi) Creek
catchments.note: from north of Jandowae past the Jinghi Jinghi gauge, west to Charleys Creek north-east of Chinchilla

catchments.name: Charleys Creek
catchments.note: from the Durong and Burra Burri country through Chinchilla, to the Condamine below Chinchilla Weir

catchments.name: North Branch Condamine (incl. Oakey Creek)
catchments.note: local catchment, from Oakey and Jondaryan to where it rejoins the Condamine south-west of Dalby; in big floods it also carries water spilt from the main river
